mất hút con mẹ hàng lươn

flags.why: Mại bản means a comprador, not a financier, investor or stock trader generally ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/m%E1%BA%A1i_b%E1%BA%A3n)).

The skirt meaning belongs to North Central dialects such as Nghệ An–Hà Tĩnh, rather than Northern Vietnamese ([regional explanation](https://nghengu.vn/tieng-nghe-cua-toi/tray-khu-man-la-gi-1115.html)).
Mấn remains a current name for headwear worn with áo dài at weddings and festivals, so rare is misleading ([current usage](https://aodaiviett.vn/collections/phu-kien-ao-dai)).
A learner today is more likely to encounter the áo dài headwear meaning than the regional skirt meaning ([current usage](https://aodaiviett.vn/collections/phu-kien-ao-dai)).

The idiom means losing the invested capital without making a profit, rather than losing capital and gains already made ([idiom dictionary](https://nguyenvietkhoa.edu.vn/tu-dien-thanh-ngu-tuc-ngu/?dir=1&name_directory_startswith=M)).
flags.fix: He invested in that project and lost his entire investment.
